subject: Reconfirming priority + proposed bump/demo windows — QuantaForge

Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-11-06T14:12:00-08:00
Subject: Next steps & post-call recap — QuantaForge / Redwood

Hi Lena — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery and suggested next steps so we’re aligned:

- Who: Lena (platform lead), 2x backend engineers, 1x security reviewer (TBD)
- Priority: ML infra modernization in H1 2026 (you estimated medium-high)
- Key constraints: VPC-only deployment requirement, data residency US-East, tight budget for POC
- Success metric: 40% lower token cost for inference on typical 32k prompts, <150ms p95 latency for small prompts

Proposed next steps:
1) Short technical demo (30–45m) focused on VPC/private deployment, caching, and quantization tradeoffs.
2) Share SOC2 / security questionnaire items you flagged.
3) If agreeable, a 2-week POC scope and mutually agreed pilot data set.

Can you let me know which of these are highest priority for you and offer 2x windows next week that work for the team? I’m cc’ing Monica (our SE) so she can slot time and prep a tailored demo.

I attached the discovery notes we took during the call (QF-discovery-notes.pdf).

Thanks —
Karthik Iyer

- Proposed bump cadence: low-friction follow-up in 5–7 business days, if no reply then another soft nudge + offer of two demo slots.
- Monica: can you prepare a 20–25m demo script focusing on VPC onboarding + caching examples (real numbers for token savings)?
- Marissa (CS): can you draft a 1-page pre-demo checklist we can send to the prospect so they can line up reviewers (security/infra)?
- Aditya: if the prospect asks for a pilot discount or accelerated SLA, should I pre-clear anything?

I attached an internal quick-playbook I used for similar accounts (internal-playbook-quantaforge.md).

Thanks,

Karthik — quick hit on what I’d lead with in the demo and what I need from the prospect if we re-engage:

- Demo highlights: VPC onboarding (5–10m), prefix/KV caching demo with before/after cost example (10m), quantization options and perf tradeoffs (5–7m), rollout/fallback policy overview (5m).
- Ask the prospect to share: representative RPS/concurrency, an example prompt distribution (avg/95th token lengths), and whether they plan to use streaming or sync calls.
- Security: we should proactively offer the SOC2/PCI packet; if they ask for on-prem options we can outline private deployment but flag delivery timeline.

I can build the demo script and have slides + a small Jupyter runbook ready in 24–36 hours if you confirm the window.

Marissa — happy to collaborate on the pre-demo checklist.

—Monica
